reason: The plugin adds a DSH approval-mode control whose bypass option automatically approves all tool calls, including file modifications and external commands, making automation the primary purpose and warranting human review.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 添加审批模式按钮，可在默认审批与自动批准工具调用之间切换。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH approval-mode control for switching between normal confirmation prompts and automatic approval of tool calls.

capabilities: Adds a UI control for selecting default or bypass approval mode
Automatically approves all tool calls when bypass mode is enabled
Allows automatically approved file modifications and external commands while retaining Workspace Write sandbox restrictions
Persists the selected mode across restarts and notifies the current session agent
